subject: Security kickoff and next steps — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Levesque <sarah.levesque@skylinerx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security kickoff and next steps — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our side and the compliance items we agreed to follow up on: 

- You wanted a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a short bridge letter while the report is processed.
- Your security team asked for Trust Portal access to review artifacts and run the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ).
- A handful of GDPR/HIPAA clarifications around data residency and processor controls were flagged — Karthik will follow up with specifics.

What you can expect from us by EOW:
1) A temporary bridge letter (PDF) that outlines our control coverage and expected delivery window for the full Type II report.
2) An invite to our Trust Portal with read-only view for your security reviewers. The portal has an intake form and a place to upload your intake/DSQ.
3) A short answers doc from Karthik on GDPR/HIPAA surface-level concerns (data residency, encryption at rest/in-transit, access controls).

Action items for SkylineRx:
- Please send over the completed security intake form (attached) or confirm you want us to populate the VSQ link and send it to you directly.
- If you require an NDA before we share the full report/bridge letter, please send the DocuSign link and we'll route to legal.

Attachments: redwood_demo_deck.pdf (copy of the demo slides), redwood_bridge_letter_temp.pdf (draft — will add signatures after NDA if needed).

Proposed timeline: portal invite + bridge letter draft by Mon 21 Jul; finalized after NDA or legal sign-off.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if helpful.

—
Logan Wright
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Levesque <sarah.levesque@skylinerx.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: James Davies <j.davies@skylinerx.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security kickoff and next steps — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the recap and for the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side: 

- We typically require an executed NDA before receiving any SOC materials — I sent a template to James to push through legal, but I can also DocuSign if that's faster.
- We prefer the portal invite to include a single reviewer and one manager (I'll send the reviewer email separately).
- The attached intake form is our standard security intake — please confirm if you want us to complete it or if you'd rather provide a VSQ link we can fill online.

A couple of compliance questions up front that we'd like to see in Karthik's answers:
- Do you support EU data residency for exports? If not, what controls do you offer to meet GDPR requirements?
- Are PHI flows permitted through the Redwood Hosted API? What are the contractual safeguards around HIPAA?

Tentative timeline from Skyline: we need bridge letter + portal access to start review this week so internal security can scoped-check by next Tue. If NDA is required, we can do it same-day.

Attaching: skyline_security_intake_form.pdf (filled).

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Information Security — SkylineRx
sarah.levesque@skylinerx.com | +1 (617) 555-0876

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Trust Portal invite & temporary bridge letter (next steps)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the intake — uploaded and reviewed. Per our internal coordination, two things are ready for you to action now: 

1) Trust Portal invite (read-only): https://app.redwood.com/trustportal/invite?token=abc123
   - The invite grants view-only access to the artifacts we've marked for vendor review. Please confirm the reviewer email once you accept.

2) Temporary bridge letter (attached): redwood_bridge_letter_temp.pdf
   - This is a concise summary of scope and controls while the Type II report is finalized. We'll provide the signed version once the NDA is returned or DocuSigned.

Karthik's note (summary):
- EU data residency: we offer region pinning on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted accounts are served from multi-region endpoints but data export controls and contractual GDPR addenda are available.
- PHI: Hosted API can be used with PHI if a signed BAA is in place — we recommend Private deployment for high-volume PHI workloads.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, role-based access controls, and audit logs available via console.

Next steps for SkylineRx:
- Accept the portal invite and confirm reviewer email.
- Return NDA (DocuSign link is fine) if you require signed copy before we exchange the final signed bridge letter and audited artifacts.
- We'll aim to deliver the full Type II report to you in the client portal as soon as it's available (ETA provided in the attached letter).

HubSpot deal link for reference: https://hubspot.com/deal/RWI-2397

If you'd like a 15-minute screen share to walk your security reviewer through the portal layout, we're available this afternoon.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
